meta.title: Iwate Kogen Snow Park
meta.description: 35–45 minutes from Morioka — family snow park with free lifts for elementary kids and daily night skiing.

transit.title:
From Morioka,
into the snow.
transit.lead: ~35–45 minutes from JR Morioka by car or bus — the closest family snow park to the Tohoku Shinkansen terminal. Free shuttle buses also run (reservation required).
transit.imgAlt: Winter drive from Morioka toward Iwate Kogen — Mt. Iwate scenery

primary.title: Kids ride free, every day
primary.lead: Elementary school kids and younger ride all lifts and the gondola free all day — standout value for families. A ~2 km gondola carries you to a 2.6 km cruise without biting wind.
primary.imgAlt: Family boarding the gondola at Iwate Kogen Snow Park

secondary.title: After skiing — Shizukuishi food & onsen
secondary.lead: From Komakusa miso ramen to Matsubokkuri gelato and Tsunagi onsen — the Shizukuishi–Morioka loop is easy to build around a ski day.

onsen.title:
After skiing,
Shizukuishi baths.
onsen.lead: Tsunagi, Amihari, and Uguisuyu onsen within ~30 minutes by car — from lakeside gensen flows to foothill classics for post-run recovery.
onsen.whisper: Day-use hours and winter operations vary — check each facility's official site.
onsen.imgAlt: Snow-view outdoor bath — Shizukuishi onsen image

tsunagi.title: Tsunagi Onsen Yukimori Hotel Daikan
tsunagi.lead: Historic Tsunagi onsen overlooking Lake Gosho — a classic stop on the way back toward Morioka (confirm hours officially).
tsunagi.imgAlt: Outdoor bath overlooking Lake Gosho — Tsunagi onsen

amihari.title: Kyukamura Iwate Amihari Onsen
amihari.lead: Famous bath with Mt. Iwate views — about 50 minutes from the slopes, ideal after advanced runs (verify officially).

uguisu.title: Hotel Mori no Kaze Uguisuyu
uguisu.lead: Uguisuyu onsen in rich nature — lavish rotenburo and creative kaiseki for stay or day-use (check winter hours).

nearbyOnsen.pairingLead: Morning: leave Morioka → afternoon: ski Iwate Kogen → evening: Matsubokkuri gelato → night: Tsunagi onsen.

komakusa.title: Restaurant Komakusa
komakusa.lead: Center Plaza's 600-seat main dining room. Crunchy bean-sprout miso ramen and house chashu bowls are classics for mid-run lunch (verify on site).

matsubokkuri.title: Matsubokkuri Ice Cream Farm
matsubokkuri.lead: Popular gelato from fresh milk and local vegetables. A few minutes downhill — a sweet reward after cold runs (check hours officially).

nearbyFood.pairingLead: Morning: rental car at Morioka → lunch: Komakusa ramen → afternoon: gondola runs → return: Matsubokkuri → evening: Tsunagi onsen.

family.title: Kids ride free every day
family.body: Elementary kids and younger ride all lifts and the gondola free. Kids room and nursing space in Center Plaza, 2,800 free parking spaces — a Morioka-area family staple.

morioka.title: Go from Morioka Station
morioka.body: ~45 minutes by free shuttle from Morioka West Exit (reservation required), or ~35–45 minutes by rental car. Easy day-trip add-on to Morioka sightseeing.

night.title: Daily night skiing
night.body: Iwate's only resort with nightly skiing every day in season. Until 21:00 weekdays and 22:00 Fri/Sat/holiday eves — for locals after work and travelers who toured until dusk.

access.note: ~35–45 min from Morioka Station by car or bus. Free shuttle requires reservation (check official site).
